test_title: PYST 10: SSC CHSL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusion(s) logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

No pen is a scale.

All scales are erasers.

All pens are calculators.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some erasers are calculators.

II. No pen is an eraser.

III. No scale is a calculator.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Both conclusions II and III follow.
Neither conclusions I, II nor III follows.
All conclusions I, II and III follow.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20198df6e5340c6dce450674553cdf1fcad4e7f245fc0a48758f89af8ac44dad.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some erasers are calculators → Does not follow (As no pen is a scale, all scales are erasers and all pens are calculators. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

II. No pen is an eraser → Does not follow (As no pen is a scale and all scales are erasers. So, no direct relation is given between erasers and scales, therefore it is false)

III. No scale is a calculator → Does not follow (As no pen is a scale and all pens are calculators. So, no direct relation is given between erasers and scales, therefore it is false)

∴ Here, Neither conclusions I, II nor III follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "**Neither conclusions I, II nor III follows**"
